messages:
laura: Heads-up — product asked if we can surface "per-invocation" cost in the console that shows raw token cost, cache savings, and model variant deltas. Want a micro-widget for route pages. Thoughts?

sam: Do you mean live calculation or sampled/day-aggregates? live will be noisy. :eyes:

laura: Prefer near-real-time-ish (1–5m granularity) for debugging expensive spikes, but aggregated view for invoices.

mike: Biggest challenge is attribution of cache savings. We have shared prefix KV hits — need a heuristic to split credit across routes/tenants. Current proposals: 1) per-request lineage (high fidelity) 2) time-window proportional split by tokens 3) give credit to the most recent request that populated the prefix.

jess: UX Q: if we show an "estimated savings" column, we need an explicit confidence level or we get support pings. Also do we show negative savings when caching regresses due to stale KV?

sam: Telemetry mismatch we saw last week: generator service reports tokens=12k, billing pipeline 11.6k. Root cause was batched streaming truncation. If we're doing near-real-time, decide which signal is canonical. I'd vote for the billing counter (post-aggregation) for totals, but streaming counter for per-invocation diagnostic breakdown.

laura: Good call. So widget should show two numbers: "diag tokens (stream)" and "billing tokens (agg)" with a tooltip explaining differences.

mike: For attribution algorithm, leaning toward hybrid: if request has explicit lineage (we track cache owner id), attribute full savings to owner; otherwise use proportional split in last-N seconds window. That keeps precision where we have it and graceful fallback otherwise.

jess: Can we show a little sparkline of cache_hit_rate next to cost so folks can correlate? Also add a "model delta" tag when model variant change affects per-token cost e.g., gpt-3-like -> quantized-ggml-4b.

anya: From product: we need cheap-to-build MVP first. Proposal: MVP shows per-invocation sample (1%) with fields: timestamp, route, diag_tokens, billing_tokens, cache_savings_est, model_sku, cost_est. No lineage attribution for MVP. Then iterate on more accurate crediting. Thoughts?

mike: +1 to sampling. Also add a flag in the sample that indicates whether the request used a cache population path so we can start measuring lineage adoption rate.

sam: Implementation note: avoid pulling entire KV traces into the UI path. Store compact cache fingerprint and owner_id in telemetry. Example event: `{"route":"/v1/generate","diag_tokens":120,"billing_tokens":116,"cache_fp":"abc123","cache_owner":"svc-A"}`. Keep it small.

laura: Agree. We should also include a small disclaimer in the UI for sampled estimates: "sampled estimate — may differ from billed totals".

jess: Also need a mockup for Console. I can do quick wireframes if you want — will surface in next sync.

anya: Can we run a 2-week canary on eng customers after we ship MVP? Need to validate confusion/support load.

laura: Yes. Action items: 1) Sam to draft telemetry event schema and canonical counters (ETA 2d). 2) Mike to prototype attribution hybrid in staging using 10% traffic (ETA 1w). 3) Jess to deliver a wireframe (ETA 3d). 4) Anya to write canary plan (ETA 1w). Sam, Mike, Jess — ping if timings unrealistic.

sam: I can do schema by Thursday.

mike: 1w ok. I'll start a spike today.

jess: Wireframe by Wed.

deploy-bot: Note: canary environment request created (#canary-2311).

laura: Thanks folks. We'll circle back after wireframes + schema. :thumbsup:
